scope: Diffusion samples one canonical MNIST digit, then a deterministic four-frame affine renderer moves that digit. GRPO acts on the canonical-image DDPM transitions but scores completed videos. Motion is procedural, not learned video diffusion.
motion_condition: vx,vy each ±2 pixels/frame, fixed by seed and shared within a group; bilinear affine translation with black padding
diffusion_policy: 20-step stochastic DDIM eta=1 on canonical 28x28 image, cosine 1000-step schedule, t_min=20, x0 clipped to [-1,1]
baseline_gate: At least 6/8 finite clips with ink mass 0.03-0.35, independent digit confidence >=0.7, independent frame-class consistency >=0.75, centroid movement >=0.7 pixels and direction cosine >=0.5; inspect all filmstrip rows

grpo_if_gate_passes.reward: proxy digit confidence times same-class fraction plus bounded motion smoothness, with ink/motion guard; no gold model in training
controls: zero adapter with same renderer and noise
grpo_if_gate_passes.primary_effect: paired trained-minus-zero proxy reward and independent gold confidence/consistency
grpo_if_gate_passes.stop_rule: Stop on nonfinite output/loss/gradients or >50% clipping for five updates

claim_scope: toy video generation with procedural motion; conditional action density is for canonical DDPM image, not a learned full-video transition or final-video likelihood
